views.name: shop_drops
views.definition:
SELECT drops.id,
    drops.week_label,
    drops.opens_at,
    drops.closes_at,
    drops.pickup_at
   FROM drops
  WHERE drops.published;

views.name: shop_products
views.definition:
SELECT products.id,
    products.name,
    products.short_name,
    products.price_cents,
    products.kind,
    products.tag,
    products.description,
    products.image_path,
    products.sort_order,
    products.allergens
   FROM products
  WHERE products.published AND products.active;
